# louisrosenblum / NFL-Machine-Learning

- **Stars:** 24 | **License:** NONE (no README, no license file) | **Pushed:** 2020-07-04 (abandoned) | **Lang:** Python 3

## Vision
A personal research repo applying machine learning to generate fantasy football projections. A learning project, not a product — "my research in applying machine learning to make fantasy football projections."

## The Ask
- Python 3 environment; no documented setup (no README fetched — endpoint returned nothing).

## Constraints
- No license, no README, untouched since 2020. There is nothing here to adopt — not even documentation of the method.

## GSE lens
Reveals no gap and no method. It's included to be blunt about the category: **most "ML fantasy projection" repos on GitHub are exactly this** — an abandoned notebook with no license, no docs, no evaluation. GSE's actual differentiator (walk-forward training on 2022–2025 + 2026 W1–4, tau calibration, the signal registry) is structurally more serious than 90% of this category's ML claims. The caution it carries: when GSE publishes, it must publish with evaluation receipts (backtests, calibration curves), or it will look like this repo with better marketing.

## Verdict
**IGNORE** — abandoned, undocumented, unlicensed; nothing to learn that GSE's training program doesn't already exceed.
